title: Very Soft!
text: Very Soft!. My daughter just moved into a new apartment for her senior year of college. Rather than getting a new comforter, we opted for a duvet cover. This one is very soft! It took both of us to put the comforter inside correctly. That's usually the case any time I put on a duvet cover. I tend to get the comforters twisted or in the wrong direction. There are ties in the corners to attach to the comforter. Her comforter had little loops just for this purpose. The closure is a zipper which I really like. The last one I used had buttons. It comes with a pair of shams. The color is a beautiful sage green. It looks really great and my daughter is very happy with it.
